purpose: Eliminate user-visible freeze caused by ending a chat execution turn after announcing a next action that was not actually started or durably closed.
root_cause: Chat execution has a hard turn boundary. Previous non-stall policies protected workers and call budgets but did not make user-visible turn completion itself transactional.
hard_invariants: NO_EXECUTION_CLAIM_WITHOUT_EVIDENCE: never state that an action is being executed unless its launch/operation has already occurred in the current turn.

TURN_COMMIT_BARRIER: before the assistant can finish a project execution turn, every action announced as started must have a durable state PASS, RUNNING_ADOPTABLE, FAIL_CLOSED, or BLOCKED_BY_INFRASTRUCTURE.
NO_PENDING_FUTURE_TENSE: an unstarted next action must be labelled PENDING_NEXT_ACTION, not 'continúo', 'ejecuto', 'procedo' or equivalent.
RUNNING_REQUIRES_IDENTITY: RUNNING is valid only with durable job/spec identity and exact process/adoption provenance when a process exists.
PASS_REQUIRES_RECEIPT: PASS requires durable receipt/hash validation.
FAIL_REQUIRES_CAUSE: FAIL/BLOCKED requires explicit root cause and next deterministic repair.
A turn boundary is not worker failure and never authorizes retry.
If the platform turn ends before a pending action starts, the pointer must still identify that action as pending and must not imply it was launched.
On the next project-related user input, resume directly from the pointer without repeating closed work.
